inner_split_rule: 20270124 + repeat_index*10 + fold;20 percent stratified outer-fit patient groups
control: Same source MLP head and feature statistics per seed; coarse/subtype prototype geometries use only the same inner fitting patients.
confirmation_gate: Retain milestone5 unless the fixed coarse expert improves mean repeated macro-F1 and the patient-cluster paired macro-F1 95 percent interval lower bound exceeds zero. No extra weight or covariance search on these new partitions.
uncertainty: Jointly resample every image and both repeated predictions of each patient; exploratory intervals do not include all training-fit uncertainty or prior search multiplicity.
external_test_policy: Original training patients only. No external images, predictions or metrics loaded.
